title: Normalized equivariant coherent Tor calculus data
statement: For a field $F$ [def-weil-field], use finite-type $F$-schemes [def-pc-scheme] [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], affine group schemes and actions [def-sc-group-scheme], coherent modules [pqf-def-coherent], actual scheme Tor [def-sfb-scheme-tor], flat morphisms [def-weil-flat-morphism], module pullback [def-pc-module-pullback] and tensor [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Define normalized Tor calculus data to consist of coherent Tor sheaves, natural affine ring-Tor comparisons, natural flat pullback comparisons compatible with identity and composition, action-groupoid linearizations given by those comparisons, and equivariant Tor maps. Exact calculus data adds equivariant connecting maps with coherent kernels and images, exactness of all adjacent pairs in both variables and the degree-zero endpoint, and compatibility of flat comparison with both boundaries. Define the affine base-change normalization by its augmentation-preserving resolution-lift formula on cycles and pure tensors. Define finite locally free calculus data by exactness of finite locally free tensor, the equivariant tensor comparison normalized by reassociation on resolution cycles, degree-zero tensor and positive-degree vanishing. The modules and linearizations are the existing scheme-groupoid descent objects [def-sfb-equivariant-coherent-gzero]; the comparison data are conclusions to be constructed, not hypotheses on the input schemes.
